races.paceDynamic: Saint Jeannais and Maskarvel will lock horns from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead alongside prominent racers Mr Mojo Risin, Anxious Moments, and Noble Don. This creates a solid early gallop that should set up the race nicely for those tracking behind. The pace won't be frantic but will be honest enough to stretch the field over the final half-mile. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks, as the early pace battle will soften up the leaders for late pickings.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace holds up as Saint Jeannais and Maskarvel duel
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for closers to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Heffalump and Knolton Park get the perfect target to aim at from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Maskarvel Gets Tactical Win
scenarios.trigger: If Maskarvel can get first run on Saint Jeannais and kick clear
scenarios.body: His progressive profile and recent second at Huntingdon suggests he can make all or lead long enough to hold off late challengers. The softer ground suits his style perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Mojo Risin or Noble Don can sit just off the pace
scenarios.body: They avoid the early battle while staying close enough to strike when the leaders weaken, benefiting from the tactical positioning without doing the donkey work. Mr Mojo Risin's recent form gives him the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Saint Jeannais can shake off Maskarvel and see off all challengers
scenarios.body: His class advantage on ratings and excellent record on similar going could see him tough it out, especially with the 176-day break potentially leaving him fresh. The strong pace would need to falter.

watchPoints.text: Saint Jeannais and Maskarvel could go too fast early if both refuse to give ground, setting up the race perfectly for hold-up horses
Heffalump and Knolton Park both return from very long breaks which could blunt their finishing kicks despite strong ratings
Charlie Deutsch on Knolton Park represents strong Venetia Williams stable confidence despite the 295-day absence
Multiple horses carry warnings about fading in finishes including Lilycala, Magna Patch and Pretty Darn Quick suggesting tactical limitations
Donald McCain has both Mr Mojo Risin and Heffalump engaged, with contrasting styles providing multiple tactical options

races.paceDynamic: Nevershedatear is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead in this 11-runner field. With most rivals preferring hold-up tactics (Greer Hill, Dante's Inferno, Dream's Ka, My Fortune, Siege Of Acres, Peace In The Park, Vinnie O'Neil), only Mr Mahler, Asta La Vista and Vesalius are positioned prominently to track the leader. This creates a classic scenario where the pacesetter can control the tempo without early pressure, before the large hold-up contingent launches their challenge from the back. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will hamper the crowded hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Nevershedatear gets soft fractions and maintains kick
scenarios.body: The lone front runner controls every call without pressure, then has enough left to repel late challengers who get caught in traffic. Hold-up horses struggle to find racing room in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Mahler or Asta La Vista sit perfectly behind Nevershedatear
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leader while avoiding the scramble behind, timing their move to perfection as Nevershedatear begins to tire. They benefit from clear racing room and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps open for Dream's Ka or Peace In The Park
scenarios.body: A soft pace allows the backmarkers to quicken dramatically, with one finding the perfect split to surge through. Harry Skelton's tactical nous gets Dream's Ka into contention despite the unfavourable setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Nevershedatear goes too slow and gets swamped by superior class
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint where ratings matter most, allowing the highest-rated hold-up horses to overcome their poor positioning. Multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Nevershedatear could steal this if getting uncontested fractions, as the pace setup heavily favours his lone front-running style
Traffic problems will be severe for hold-up horses like Greer Hill and Siege Of Acres in this 11-runner field with limited early pace
Mr Mahler and Asta La Vista are the key dangers to the leader, positioned prominently to get first run without getting caught behind
Dream's Ka needs Harry Skelton to work magic from hold-up position, relying on gaps opening at crucial moment
The good ground conditions favour most runners, removing going concerns as a significant variable

races.paceDynamic: Krak stands out as the sole genuine front-runner and will likely control this race from the gates, with prominent runners Diamonds Galore and City Of Diamonds settling just behind. The majority of this field are hold-up performers (Fasol, Fromheretoeternity, Dog Fox, Roysse, Itsinthename, Paddockwood) who will need the race to develop. With limited early pace pressure on Krak, he can dictate a comfortable gallop that may not provide the strong tempo these back-markers typically require. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leader and those hold-up horses proven effective in slowly-run races.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Krak maintains an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy before asserting, while most hold-up horses struggle to quicken from their backward positions. This tactical advantage overcomes his recent poor form when getting the race run to suit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace creates a cavalry charge finish with multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The strong stamina and finishing kick of the Paul Nicholls-trained Fasol proves decisive in a tactical affair. Dog Fox's excellent course record (2 wins from 15 runs here) and fresh legs from a 173-day break also come into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Success
scenarios.trigger: If Diamonds Galore or City Of Diamonds position perfectly behind Krak and outfinish him
scenarios.body: The Henderson runner's consistent recent form (222P1) and ability to race prominently without over-racing gives the tactical edge. Recent winners often benefit from this patient prominent style when the pace is modest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Krak compounds or falls, leaving no early pace whatsoever
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair develops where experience and tactical nous matter most, favouring the older campaigners. Fromheretoeternity's 9-year-old's racecraft and recent second at this trip becomes the deciding factor.

watchPoints.text: Krak's jumping under pressure - if he makes mistakes when challenged, this race opens up dramatically for the hold-up horses
Early sectionals behind Krak - if he goes too slow, the finish becomes a lottery favouring horses with the most natural speed
Fasol's position turning for home - Hanlon must have him close enough to strike as this Nicholls runner has the class edge
Dog Fox's fitness first time back - if sharp despite the 173-day break, his course form makes him very dangerous
Diamonds Galore's jumping rhythm - any hesitation at obstacles will compromise his prominent position and tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Personal Ambition and Obsessedwithyou will contest the early lead in this small field, with both horses showing confirmed front-running tendencies. Personal Ambition has been prominent or leading in recent runs while Obsessedwithyou has won twice from the front recently. Their dual ensures an honest gallop from the start, preventing any crawling pace that could complicate the race. This tempo strongly favours the prominent runners and hold-up horses who can track the pace and finish strongly, rather than the leaders themselves who may pay for their early exertions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too hard early and weaken significantly from 3 furlongs out.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for Gabriel's Getaway and Homme Public to close late with their preferred hold-up style. Both have the class to capitalize when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit just behind the leaders and time their run perfectly.
scenarios.body: Calico or Grain d'Oudairies can track the early pace without getting embroiled in the battle, then strike when the leaders weaken. Their tactical positioning proves crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more controlled than expected and one leader lasts home.
scenarios.body: Personal Ambition's higher class rating could see him dominate from the front if Obsessedwithyou doesn't go with him early. His stamina over this trip under less pressure would be key.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sir Tivo's comeback
scenarios.trigger: If the 213-day layoff hasn't dulled Sir Tivo's ability and he finds his old spark.
scenarios.body: The veteran's good record on similar going could see him benefit from the strong pace despite his long absence. His prominent style would need perfect timing to overcome fresher rivals.

watchPoints.text: Personal Ambition and Obsessedwithyou could go too fast early and both weaken dramatically in the final furlong.
Gabriel's Getaway needs to be handy enough turning for home given his hold-up style and lengthy absence.
Sir Tivo's market movement will be crucial given his 213-day break and whether connections expect him fit enough.
Calico's position behind the leaders will be key to whether he can time his run to catch tired front runners.
The pace through the first mile will determine if this becomes a sprint finish or stamina test.

races.paceDynamic: Kenzo Des Bruyeres will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge his early dominance, allowing him to dictate terms at a sustainable gallop. The congestion comes behind him where Cahier's Den, Special John, Good Work, Slaney Opera, Gilbertina and Friends Don't Ask all want prominent positions, creating a wall of traffic that could prove decisive 2-3 fences from home. Walking The Walk and Getaway Glory will be held up at the back by Bass and Todd respectively, relying on gaps appearing late. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader Kenzo Des Bruyeres and the two hold-up horses who can avoid the mid-race scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres jumps cleanly and maintains his uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The Mickey Bowen-trained leader can control the tempo without pressure and kick clear when the prominent pack tangles behind him. His front-running style perfectly suits the lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create serious traffic problems turning for home
scenarios.body: Walking The Walk or Getaway Glory can exploit the congestion by finding clear runs when others are stopped in their tracks. David Bass's experience on Walking The Walk becomes crucial in navigating the chaos.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Escapes Trouble
scenarios.trigger: If one of the six prominent runners secures prime position without interference
scenarios.body: Special John or Slaney Opera could use their higher class ratings to power through if they avoid the worst of the scrimmaging. Their recent good form suggests they have the engine to overcome tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres falters badly and the prominent pack goes too slow early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Friends Don't Ask's recent win could prove telling despite his age. This scenario requires multiple things to go wrong up front.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early scrimmaging between the six prominent runners (Cahier's Den, Special John, Good Work, Slaney Opera, Gilbertina, Friends Don't Ask) creating a wall of horses behind Kenzo Des Bruyeres
Monitor Kenzo Des Bruyeres jumping - any mistake from the uncontested leader opens the door for hold-up horses Walking The Walk and Getaway Glory
Observe Special John and Slaney Opera securing good positions early as they have the class to win if avoiding traffic problems
Watch David Bass on Walking The Walk for his positioning moves from 4 out - his experience crucial in finding gaps when others are stopped
Check Good Work's jumping given the pull-up last time and whether first-time headgear helps his concentration over this longer trip

races.paceDynamic: Pigeon House, Is This For Real, and Nibras Gold will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to contest the early lead. The pace will be testing throughout this 2m1½f trip, especially with Pigeon House returning from a 73-day break and needing to prove fitness. Nibras Gold carries top weight after 231 days off, while Is This For Real brings the best recent form. This sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses Ice In The Veins and King Ulanda to finish strongly, making this a race that heavily favours patient tactical rides.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and weaken
scenarios.body: The strong pace will find out the leaders' stamina reserves, allowing Ice In The Veins and King Ulanda to pick up the pieces with their superior finishing kicks. Harry Skelton's tactical nous on Ice In The Veins becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives pace
scenarios.trigger: If Is This For Real can dictate fractions and stay
scenarios.body: Despite the presence of other leaders, Is This For Real's recent winning form allows him to control the tempo and maintain just enough in reserve. The Fergal O'Brien-trained gelding proves his class at this level.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or becomes messy
scenarios.body: Park Annonciade and Hudson can position themselves perfectly behind the battling leaders without getting involved in early skirmishes. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike when the genuine pace horses weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Nibras Gold class tells
scenarios.trigger: If the top-weighted veteran shows no rust from his break
scenarios.body: James Owen's charge overcomes the 231-day layoff and weight burden through sheer class and experience. His superior rating begins to tell in the closing stages despite the pace pressure.

watchPoints.text: Pigeon House could set unsustainable fractions if he battles early with Is This For Real and Nibras Gold, potentially setting up a pace collapse.
Ice In The Veins needs the predicted strong pace to develop his finishing kick - any slow tempo will blunt his main weapon.
Nibras Gold's jumping must be monitored closely given his lengthy absence and the pressure he'll face from fellow front-runners.
King Ulanda requires the leaders to go fast enough to come back to him, as his recent form suggests he needs everything in his favour.
Watch for Harry Skelton positioning Ice In The Veins perfectly in behind the speed battle to maximise his finishing effort.
